name: Touchtry Interactive
author: touchtry

sections.description:
Touchtry Interactive is a lightweight WooCommerce plugin that enables interactive AR-based product viewing on WooCommerce product pages.

Store owners can connect supported product experiences and show a Try On button directly on WooCommerce product pages. This helps customers explore products more confidently before buying.

Features:

  • Add interactive Try On button to WooCommerce product pages
  • Enable or disable AR per product
  • Add AR model/viewer URL per WooCommerce product
  • Lightweight and simple setup
  • Works with WooCommerce products
  • Helps improve product engagement
  • No coding required for basic usage

External Services

This plugin connects to the TouchTry service to fetch AR model data and to link TouchTry AR experiences with WooCommerce products.

Service provider:
TouchTry

Service URL:
https://touchtry.com

What the service is used for:
The TouchTry service is used to manage AR/3D product experiences and provide AR viewer links that can be connected with WooCommerce products.

What data is sent:
When a store administrator opens the plugin admin page and uses the model picker, the plugin may send a request to TouchTry servers to fetch available AR models. This request may include standard technical request data such as the site URL, IP address, browser user agent, and plugin/admin request context. Product-specific AR model URLs selected by the store administrator may be saved in the WordPress database.

When data is sent:
Data is sent only when the store administrator uses the plugin admin interface to fetch or connect AR models. The plugin does not send WooCommerce customer order data to TouchTry through this model picker request.

Why data is sent:
Data is sent to display available AR models and allow the store administrator to connect those AR experiences with WooCommerce products.

Terms of Service:
https://touchtry.com/terms-and-conditions/

Privacy Policy:
https://touchtry.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/touchtry-interactive directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to the Touchtry AR admin page or product edit page to configure the product AR experience.
  5. Save changes and test the Try On button on the WooCommerce product page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin is designed for WooCommerce product pages.

Does it collect personal user data?

The plugin itself does not collect or store sensitive personal customer data. It stores AR configuration data, such as AR model/viewer URLs, in the WordPress database. When the administrator uses the model picker, the plugin connects to the TouchTry service to fetch AR model data as described in the External Services section.

Does this plugin connect to an external service?

Yes. The plugin connects to the TouchTry service when the administrator uses the model picker or connects AR models with WooCommerce products. Details are provided in the External Services section.

Does it require coding knowledge?

No. Basic setup can be done from the WordPress admin panel.

What file format is supported for AR models?

TouchTry commonly uses GLB/3D model files for AR product experiences. The exact AR viewer link is managed through the TouchTry dashboard.
